title: Linear stress scenarios, ranking and worst-case contributors
source:
"""Linear stress P&L by scenario, loss ranking, and worst-case contributors.

Everything turns on units. Equity shocks are percentages applied to market
value through beta (so -38 means -0.38); rate and spread sensitivities are
quoted per +1bp and multiply the shock in bp directly; FX and commodity deltas
are per +1% and multiply the shock in percent directly. Mixing those - dividing
the bp shocks by 10,000, or the delta shocks by 100 - is the classic error.

Ties are broken deterministically (scenario name, position id) so the ranking
is a function of the inputs alone.
"""
import os

import pandas as pd

DATA = "/input/environment/data"
OUT_DIR = "/app/output"


def main() -> None:
    pos = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA}/positions.csv")
    scenarios = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA}/scenarios.csv")

    by_scenario = {}
    for s in scenarios.itertuples(index=False):
        by_scenario[s.scenario] = (pos["market_value"] * pos["equity_beta"] * s.equity_shock_pct / 100.0
                                   + pos["dv01"] * s.rate_shock_bp
                                   + pos["cs01"] * s.credit_spread_shock_bp
                                   + pos["fx_delta_per_pct"] * s.fx_shock_pct
                                   + pos["commodity_delta_per_pct"] * s.commodity_shock_pct)

    totals = pd.DataFrame({"scenario": list(by_scenario),
                           "total_pnl": [float(p.sum()) for p in by_scenario.values()]})
    totals = totals.sort_values(["total_pnl", "scenario"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    totals["loss_rank"] = range(1, len(totals) + 1)

    worst = totals.loc[0, "scenario"]
    frame = pd.DataFrame({"position_id": pos["position_id"], "asset_class": pos["asset_class"],
                          "pnl": by_scenario[worst]})
    top = frame.sort_values(["pnl", "position_id"]).head(3).copy()
    top["share_of_scenario_loss"] = top["pnl"] / totals.loc[0, "total_pnl"]

    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    totals[["scenario", "total_pnl", "loss_rank"]].to_csv(
        os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "scenario_pnl.csv"), index=False, float_format="%.17g")
    top.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "worst_case_contributors.csv"), index=False, float_format="%.17g")
    print(totals)
    print(top)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
